assertions.name: stage_c_operator_data_assembled
assertions.source: Stage C deliverable: per-block chi closed forms (q^3, 0, -q^{-3}) from PR #1873, Wenzl weights y_lambda(q) symbolic from y_lambda_wenzl_bridge, combined into tr_M(trefoil)(q) exact rational. c_k-as-u-Taylor AROUND u=0 is impossible (u quadratic in q-1, sqrt branch at u=0) — confirms PR #1840. LOCAL Taylor AROUND u_0 IS well-defined (du/dt = 0.140 at q_0), enabling nonlinear c_k extraction; see qbeta_ck_local_taylor_around_u0_probe.py follow-up.

description: c_4..c_8 extraction attempt from the operator-level Markov trace of the trefoil. Combines PR #1873's clean chi closed forms (q^3, 0, -q^{-3}) with y_lambda_wenzl_bridge symbolic weights; expands R(q) = tr_M / [Q_A*cos(alpha_eff)] in u = b*hbar_q^2 around q_0 to read off c_k. Gate: c_2 = -1.

verdict.reason_zero_impossible: u ~ (q-1)^2 near q=1, so q->u reversion needs sqrt(u); the c_k ladder is non-analytic at u=0.
verdict.reason_u0_works: At substrate q_0, du/dt = 0.1398 != 0, so local series reversion is well-defined; the global c_k can be extracted from nonlinear matching of local Taylor of R around u_0 against the ladder expansion.
productive_directions: LOCAL TAYLOR around u_0 via series reversion: see qbeta_ck_local_taylor_around_u0_probe.py (follow-up).
PER-RUNG operator identities (like PR #1786's c_2 = -1 from (1-u^2) factor at N=2). Each c_k needs its own operator-level analog.
